description:
Can you collect them all?
Want to restore the planet's ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 100 people to join Planet Wild with my code PRACTICAL29 will get the first month paid for by me: https://planetwild.com/r/practicalengineering/join/29
If you want to get to know them better first, check out their mission rewilding transmission lines: https://planetwild.com/r/practicalengineering/m15/29

Just like the periodic table of the elements, the NEMA connection standards are a bit messy. And that’s what I love about them.

📖My new book, Disasters By Design: How Engineering Failures Shaped the Modern World is coming March 2, 2027 and available for preorder now.
